blurb:
Downtown Houston Tour (2.5 Hours) Pickup from your hotel, Dive deep into the heart of the city. Explore Market Square Park, the historic 1910 Harris County Courthouse, the JPMorgan Chase Tower, Daikin Park, Buffalo Bayou trails, and the vibrant East Downtown mural scene. Your guide shares stories of Houston’s history from its founding in 1836 to its modern skyline.
See Colleges, stadiums, landmarks, parks, Museums. End your tour at Houston Zoo, one of its 21 nearby museums or return to your starting point. 
Brochures, dining vouchers, coupons from participating merchants, 1 Free souvenir for every (2) persons in your party are provided
